messages.content: Great, let's start with IEEE-style requirement gathering for your game management app. No technical knowledge is needed—just share your vision and I'll help structure it.

analysis_summary: We're building a game management app to help organize and track games. Let's clarify the key details to make sure we build exactly what you need.

question_plan.summary: We're building a game management app to help organize and track games. Let's clarify the key details to make sure we build exactly what you need.

questions.question: Who will be using this app to manage games?
What are the most important things people should be able to do in your game management app?
questions.placeholder: Example: create game sessions, track scores, manage teams, schedule events

questions.question: Where do you want people to access your game management app?
How should users sign in to access the app?
Does your game management app need to connect with any other services or platforms?
questions.placeholder: Example: gaming platforms, calendar services, payment systems, messaging apps

questions.question: What kind of updates, reminders, or reports should the app provide?
questions.placeholder: Example: game session reminders, score updates, performance reports, event notifications

questions.question: Are there any privacy or safety considerations for your game management app?
About how many users do you expect to have when you launch the app?

introduction.purpose: This document specifies the functional and non-functional requirements for the Game Management Application, ensuring clear communication between stakeholders and development teams.

product_scope.summary: The Game Management Application enables users to organize their game collections, track play status, manage metadata, and generate structured documentation through an intuitive web interface.
business_objectives: Provide users with a centralized platform for game management
Reduce manual effort in game tracking and documentation
Enable easy sharing and export of game collections
benefits: Enhanced user experience with AI-guided features
goals: Deliver a fully functional game management application
Support JSON and PDF export capabilities
Ensure high usability for non-technical users

product_perspective.system_context: The Game Management Application is a web-based system that includes a frontend interface, backend API services, AI processing capabilities, and persistent storage for game data and generated artifacts.

related_systems.name: Authentication Service
related_systems.interface_summary: Handles user authentication and session management

related_systems.name: File Storage Service
related_systems.interface_summary: Manages storage and retrieval of uploaded game files and generated artifacts

product_perspective.context_diagram_reference: Diagram generation is deferred. Review the analyst workspace and service breakdown for the current phase.

product_functions.name: Dashboard and Game Overview
product_functions.description: Provides a centralized view of all games in the collection with summary statistics and quick access to game details

product_functions.name: Multimodal Game Input
product_functions.description: Supports multiple input methods including manual entry, file uploads, and voice input for adding games to the collection

product_functions.name: AI-Guided Game Documentation
product_functions.description: Uses artificial intelligence to guide users through comprehensive game documentation and metadata capture

product_functions.name: Structured Documentation Generation
product_functions.description: Automatically generates well-structured game documentation based on collected information

product_functions.name: JSON and PDF Export
product_functions.description: Enables export of game collections and documentation in both machine-readable JSON and human-readable PDF formats

user_classes_and_characteristics.description: Users who maintain personal game collections and want to track their gaming activities
Users with extensive game collections requiring detailed organization and documentation
Professionals who need to manage and document their game development projects

user_interfaces.name: Game Dashboard
user_interfaces.description: Main interface showing game collection overview, statistics, and quick access to all features

user_interfaces.name: Game Entry Form
user_interfaces.description: Form for adding new games with support for text input, file uploads, and optional voice input

user_interfaces.name: Documentation Workspace
user_interfaces.description: Interactive interface for AI-guided game documentation and metadata collection

user_interfaces.name: Export Management
user_interfaces.description: Interface for selecting and exporting game data in various formats with customization options

software_interfaces.description: Provides programmatic access to game data, user management, and export functionality
Handles upload, storage, and processing of game-related files and documents
Provides artificial intelligence capabilities for guided documentation and metadata extraction

description_and_priority.description: Comprehensive management of game collections including adding, editing, deleting, and organizing games

functional_requirements.title: Game Entry Creation
functional_requirements.description: The system shall allow users to create new game entries with basic metadata including title, platform, genre, and release date
acceptance_criteria: Users can successfully create new game entries
All required metadata fields are validated
Games appear in the collection after creation

functional_requirements.title: Game Editing
functional_requirements.description: The system shall allow users to edit existing game entries and update metadata
acceptance_criteria: Users can modify game details
Changes are persisted immediately
Edit history is maintained for audit purposes

description_and_priority.description: Support for multiple input methods including manual entry, file uploads, and voice input

stimulus_response_sequences.system_response: The system processes the request and shows a clear status update.
postconditions: The updated result is available for review.

functional_requirements.title: File Upload Processing
functional_requirements.description: The system shall process uploaded game files including images, documents, and metadata files
acceptance_criteria: Files are successfully uploaded and stored
Metadata is extracted from supported file types
Upload progress is clearly indicated to users

functional_requirements.title: Voice Input Support
functional_requirements.description: The system shall support voice input for game metadata entry where supported by the user's device
acceptance_criteria: Voice input is accurately transcribed
Transcripts are properly formatted as game metadata
Voice input availability is clearly indicated

description_and_priority.description: Intelligent assistance for comprehensive game documentation through guided interviews

stimulus_response_sequences.system_response: The system processes the request and shows a clear status update.
postconditions: The updated result is available for review.

functional_requirements.title: Interactive Interview
functional_requirements.description: The system shall provide an interactive interview process to guide users through comprehensive game documentation
acceptance_criteria: Interview questions are contextually relevant
Progress is saved between sessions
Users can navigate forward and backward through questions

functional_requirements.title: Smart Suggestions
functional_requirements.description: The system shall provide intelligent suggestions based on previously entered information
acceptance_criteria: Suggestions are contextually appropriate
Users can accept or reject suggestions
Suggestions improve with usage patterns

description_and_priority.description: Generation and export of game documentation in multiple formats

stimulus_response_sequences.system_response: The system processes the request and shows a clear status update.
postconditions: The updated result is available for review.

functional_requirements.title: JSON Export
functional_requirements.description: The system shall export game data and documentation in structured JSON format
acceptance_criteria: JSON exports contain all relevant game data
Export format follows consistent schema
Exports are downloadable immediately

functional_requirements.title: PDF Export
functional_requirements.description: The system shall generate and export professional PDF documents of game collections
acceptance_criteria: PDFs are properly formatted and readable
Exports include all selected game data
PDF generation completes within reasonable time

performance_requirements.description: The system shall load the main dashboard within 2 seconds under normal load conditions
Game search operations shall return results within 1 second for collections up to 10,000 games
PDF generation shall complete within 30 seconds for typical game collections
API responses shall have a 95th percentile latency under 500 milliseconds

safety_requirements.description: The system shall prevent accidental loss of active project work.
safety_requirements.hazard: Loss of project inputs or artifacts

security_requirements.description: All user data shall be encrypted in transit using TLS 1.2 or higher
User authentication shall be required for accessing personal game collections
File uploads shall be scanned for malware before processing
Session management shall include automatic timeout after 30 minutes of inactivity
Role-based access control shall prevent unauthorized access to user data

software_quality_attributes.description: Non-technical users should complete the intake and answer flow without training.

business_rules.description: Games marked as completed shall be moved to a separate 'Completed Games' section
Users can only export their own game collections, not other users' data
Free accounts are limited to 100 games; premium accounts have unlimited storage
Exported documents shall include watermark for free account users
Game metadata validation shall enforce required fields before documentation generation

database_requirements.description: The database shall store game metadata, user profiles, session data, and export history
Data retention policy shall maintain user data for at least 2 years after account deletion request
Daily automated backups shall be performed with point-in-time recovery capability
Database shall support concurrent access from multiple application instances
Indexing shall be optimized for common search patterns and filtering operations

internationalization_requirements.description: The product should support future localization without changing the API contract.
locale_rules: ISO date formatting for API payloads

legal_requirements.description: The system shall comply with GDPR requirements for user data protection and privacy
Users shall be provided with clear terms of service and privacy policy
Data export functionality shall support right-to-access requests
All AI processing shall comply with applicable AI ethics and transparency regulations

reuse_objectives.description: Reuse question planning, validation, and export modules across future agents.

additional_requirements.description: The application shall be accessible via modern web browsers including Chrome, Firefox, Safari, and Edge
Mobile-responsive design shall provide optimal experience on smartphones and tablets
Progressive Web App capabilities shall be implemented for offline functionality
Comprehensive logging shall be implemented for debugging and audit purposes
The system shall support future integration with popular gaming platforms and APIs

services.summary: Handles core game data operations including CRUD operations, search, and collection management
Responsible for generating structured documentation and export artifacts in JSON and PDF formats
Provides artificial intelligence capabilities for guided interviews and smart suggestions
Manages storage, retrieval, and processing of uploaded files and generated documents
Handles user registration, login, session management, and access control

analyst_workspace.analysis_summary: This Software Requirements Specification defines the requirements for a Game Management Application designed to help users organize, track, and manage their game collections. The system provides a comprehensive dashboard for game overview, supports multimodal input methods, includes AI-guided requirement capture, generates structured documentation, and enables export of artifacts in JSON and PDF formats. The application targets general users with varying technical expertise and focuses on usability, security, and performance.
